title: Rear setback (R17.5 and above): no provision
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, rear setback: R5 and above 3m (applicable to R5-R15 only).

replaces.note: R5-R15 rear 6 m -> 3 m; R2 and R2.5 unchanged
rear setbacks by Tables 2a/2b at R17.5-R40 have no draft equivalent
Part C applied Table 3.4a to all boundaries

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: AMBIGUITY (register ch2-055, high priority): the draft gives no rear setback for R17.5+ (Table 2A N/A). Encoded as NOT_APPLICABLE through the null row, not as the side-setback values. Either reading needs confirmation. R100-SL added to coding: Table 2.10a does not modify rear setbacks and Table 2A (draft p7, extract line 189) shows N/A spanning R17.5 to R100-SL.

verified.note: The rear cell for 'R5 and above' reads '3m (applicable to R5-R15 only)' and nothing else; Table 2A (p7) prints N/A for R17.5 to R100-SL. The page does not say whether R17.5+ has no rear setback or falls back to the side setback values (register ch2-055).
